name: nubint
description: Review manuscripts, verify references, find real papers, edit Nubint documents side by side and make scientific figures with Nubint.

interface.shortDescription: Research writing: review manuscripts, verify references, find papers, make figures.
interface.longDescription: Nubint is an AI research-writing workspace with a scholarly paper index. Check that every reference is real, run peer review and claim-credibility reviews on a manuscript, search and save real papers, propose edits to a document open in the Nubint editor, and make publication-ready illustrations, flowcharts and charts from real data.
defaultPrompt: Connect to Nubint in a dedicated task, check the connection and my plan, and introduce what Nubint can do for my research writing.
